blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard District (PGD) of Palawan said sea travel for small boats was temporarily suspended on Wednesday, Nov. 11, due to the effects of the northeast monsoon, or amihan. In an advisory, CGD-Palawan said vessels of 15 gross tonnage (GT) and below were prohibited from sailing in the following areas: Coast Guard Station (CGS) Southern Palawan CGS North Eastern Palawan READ: Amihan, easterlies to bring rains over parts of PH on Nov. 11 Meanwhile, vessels of 3 GT and below were also prohibited from sailing in the following areas: CGS Southern Palawan CGS South Central Palawan […]...
